data.one_liner: WeChat SDK Flutter plugin without payment for App Store compliance.
data.what_it_does: Provides WeChat integration APIs like sharing, auth, and mini programs while omitting payment features to pass iOS App Store payment compliance reviews.
use_when: You need WeChat integration (sharing, login, mini programs) in a Flutter app distributed on the iOS App Store
You want to avoid Apple's payment review rejections caused by native WeChat payment hooks
avoid_when: Your app requires WeChat payment functionality
You are using the standard fluwx package which includes payment methods
strengths: Identical API to fluwx for easy swapping
Helps pass iOS App Store compliance review by omitting payment methods
weaknesses: Calling payment methods will result in a MissingPluginException
Requires platform-specific configuration such as Universal Links on iOS and fingerprint registration on Android
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Associated Domains, URL types, and LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in iOS Info.plist, and registering the app signature fingerprint on Android.

alternatives.name: fluwx
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick fluwx if you actually need WeChat payment features built-in and do not have App Store compliance issues regarding payments.
